newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bunge makes takeover bid for Defiance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bunge makes takeover bid for Defiance.

text.p: Latin American-based food and industrial conglomerate Bunge Corp said on Tuesday that its local unit had made a A$1.70 per share takeover bid for flour and bakery group Defiance Mills Ltd, valuing the company at A$97 million.
Defiance shares ended five cents lower at A$1.60 on Tuesday.
A spokesman for Defiance said company officials were in a meeting on Tuesday afternoon.

Bunge said its Bunge Foods Queensland Pty Ltd unit would also offer A$2.10 per share cash for the Australian preference shares and NZ$2.07 cash per share for New Zealand preference shares. It said the aggregate value of $97 million for the varying classes of stock represented a multiple of 20.6 times on the net income earned by Defiance in calendar 1996 and a multiple of 12.3 times earning before interest and tax.

"The combination of the Defiance and Bunge businesses will create a significant Australian milling and baking company with strong market positions in Queensland and Victoria, better able to compete with the relative strength of the national producers, and provide a more stable businesses environment for the business and its employees," Bunge said in a statement.

It said the bid was expected to be sent to Defiance shareholders at the end of March and was conditional on receiving not less than 75 percent of the ordinary shares as well as regulatory approvals. Defiance is based in the Darling Downs town of Toowoomba, in southwest Queensland.
Bunge Australia and major local food company Goodman Fielder Ltd abandoned a proposal to merge their Australian milling operations in May last year.
